briefdescription.para: Integration test — requires an actual LDAP / Active Directory server.

detaileddescription.para:
To run this test:
Set up an OpenLDAP or Active Directory test server.
Create a test user, e.g., "testuser" with password "testpass".
Build ThemisDB with -DTHEMIS_ENABLE_LDAP=ON.
Run: ctest -R LDAPAuthenticator.DISABLED_IntegrationWithLDAPServer
